name: TOTP Sign-In Token Endpoint
summary: Maps anonymous mobile TOTP authentication to the normalized authentication flow and the existing access/refresh-token issuance pipeline.

sourceReferences.note: AllowAnonymous endpoint delegates to IAuthenticationFlowService.AuthenticateWithTotpTokenAsync; accepted proof is internally exchanged through the existing single-use-token grant pipeline so mobile receives the standard AuthResponse token contract in one external operation.
